notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). PlayStation 4 only (RAWG lists only PlayStation 4), and the Steam store list has no app with this name, so steam=None. RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3601). StrategyWiki has the guide under "InFAMOUS: First Light" (the title as given redirects there) at completion stage 0. Only 4 subpages exist: Trophies (about 3,200 characters), Prologue (about 1,100), Challenges (about 900) and Table of Contents; Gameplay, Controls, Introduction, Walkthrough, every mission after the Prologue, the challenge and arena pages are linked but not written. The chapters use the contents page names in contents order (swNames): Prologue, Free the Neon, Stealing From the Enemy, Violence in Seattle, Tracking the Trafficker, Akurans Strike Back, Assault the Motherland, Conduit Consequences, Surveillance Blackout, Price of Redemption, Kingpin of Seattle and Finale, then Challenges and Arenas (Survival, Rescue). Splitting the twelve story pages into three chapters of four is our own choice, and the summaries are only placeholders built from the page names. infamous.fandom.com redirects "inFAMOUS: First Light" to "Infamous: First Light", with about 39 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
